_comment: UE collision profile -> physics layer mapping (plan M3).
Collision channel mapping is LOSSY AND EXPLICIT by design: UE has 32
channels with per-channel Block/Overlap/Ignore responses per profile;
O3DE backends have collision layers plus a collides-with mask, and the
two models do not translate 1:1. This file maps each UE profile name to
a layer name per backend; anything absent uses `_fallback` and the
importer reports PHYS_PROFILE_FALLBACK so the loss is visible.
Layer names are NOT guaranteed to mean the same thing across backends
(plan M3b), hence the per-backend sections. v1 maps everything to the
default layer -- fixture profiles are BlockAll/Trigger/NoCollision, and
trigger semantics are carried by the sensor flag, not the layer. Real
layer wiring is deliberate follow-on work once a target project defines
